commit eee50cfec608dd47f846a113056c95eb010e2cde
Author:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
AuthorDate: Sat Jan 17 11:36:34 2026 +0200
Commit:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
CommitDate: Sat Jan 17 11:36:34 2026 +0200

    Bug 2009279 - Fix add-on icon not displayed in message context menu. r=freaktechnik
    
    
    The migration from `<xul:image>` to `<html:img>` in Bug 1979338 defaulted
    menu icons to `loading="lazy"`. While static chrome menus handle this
    gracefully, menus constructed dynamically via JS Actors (such as WebExtension
    context menus) fail to resolve these icons when the menu overflows the
    parent window.
    
    When the menu exists on a separate OS surface/window, the Intersection
    Observer used by lazy loading cannot reliably calculate visibility
    against the parent viewport during the initial actor-driven render.
    
    This patch forces `loading="eager"` via a microtask immediately after
    the icon attribute is set. This ensures the rendering engine ignores
    viewport intersection checks and resolves the icon URI immediately,
    fixing blank icons in Thunderbird's content-area context menus.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D278587

diff --git a/mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-menus.js b/mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-menus.js
index 152d7f04b90..45f91ada81b 100644
--- a/mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-menus.js
+++ b/mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-menus.js
@@ -514,7 +514,22 @@ var gMenuBuilder = {
       element.setAttribute("class", "menuitem-iconic");
     }
 
-    element.setAttribute("image", resolvedURL);
+    element.setAttribute("image", ChromeUtils.encodeURIForSrcset(resolvedURL));
+
+    // Workaround for a regression introduced in Bug 1979338.
+    // When a menu is dynamically constructed via JS Actors (as is the case
+    // for extension context menus) and positioned outside the parent
+    // window's bounds, 'loading="lazy"' icons fail to resolve because they
+    // fall outside the primary window's intersection observer viewport.
+    // We use a microtask to wait for the toolkit to construct the anonymous
+    // <html:img> and then force 'loading="eager"' to ensure the icon is
+    // painted regardless of window overflow.
+    parentWindow.Promise.resolve().then(() => {
+      const menuIcon = element.querySelector(".menu-icon");
+      if (menuIcon) {
+        menuIcon.loading = "eager";
+      }
+    });
   },
 
   // Undo changes from setMenuItemIcon.
title: Bug 2009279 - Fix add-on icon not displayed in message context menu. r=freaktechnik
